title: JejakBahari
subtitle: Open Maritime / RoRo Tracking Project
shortDescription: An open-source project exploring vessel, port, route, and AIS data for Indonesian RoRo tracking.
problem: Indonesian RoRo and maritime visibility depends on scattered public data sources for vessels, ports, and routes.
solution: An open project that researches AIS and public maritime data sources and models port and vessel data around a RoRo-first scope.
impact: Designed as a reusable open maritime-data project
